detail.longDescription:
OKAY, broad question, my loves: 

Have any of you moved from Wordpress to Ghost?

I've been a Wordpress user since 2007. I'm really good at it. I'm also REALLY frustrated with bloat and poor coding.

Ghost looks great, but I'm nervous it won't be as customizable at all, and might lock me into another proprietary system - not to mention I'd want to self-host so no one but me has control over my information.

Any thoughts? Experiences? I'd appreciate it!

#ghost #wordpress #technology #programming
